WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`,
    b.closePricePosition AS `v2`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
history_ranked AS (
  SELECT history.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate DESC) AS observation_rank
  FROM history
),
observed_tail AS (
  SELECT * FROM history_ranked WHERE observation_rank<=20
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT observed_tail.*, `v1` - LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) AS `price_delta`
  FROM observed_tail
),
features AS (
  SELECT deltas.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(price_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 5 THEN 100 - 100 / (1 + (AVG(GREATEST(price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) / NULLIF(AVG(GREATEST(-price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`,
    CASE WHEN NOT (COUNT(`v2`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 20) OR MAX(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) THEN NULL WHEN CAST(3 AS DECIMAL(1,0))*(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) <= (MAX(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) THEN '低' WHEN CAST(3 AS DECIMAL(1,0))*(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) >= CAST(2 AS DECIMAL(1,0))*(MAX(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) THEN '高' ELSE '中' END AS `f2`
  FROM deltas
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE ((`f1` > ?) AND (`f2` = ?))

),
history_ranked AS (

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`,
    b.closePricePosition AS `v2`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
history_ranked AS (
  SELECT history.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate DESC) AS observation_rank
  FROM history
),
observed_tail AS (
  SELECT * FROM history_ranked WHERE observation_rank<=20
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT observed_tail.*, `v1` - LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) AS `price_delta`
  FROM observed_tail
),
features AS (
  SELECT deltas.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(price_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 5 THEN 100 - 100 / (1 + (AVG(GREATEST(price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) / NULLIF(AVG(GREATEST(-price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`,
    CASE WHEN NOT (COUNT(`v2`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 20) OR MAX(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) THEN NULL WHEN CAST(3 AS DECIMAL(1,0))*(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) <= (MAX(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) THEN '低' WHEN CAST(3 AS DECIMAL(1,0))*(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) >= CAST(2 AS DECIMAL(1,0))*(MAX(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)-MIN(CAST(`v2` AS DECIMAL(36,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) THEN '高' ELSE '中' END AS `f2`
  FROM deltas
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
),
coverage_flags AS (
  SELECT cov.mktcode,cov.tgtcode,0 AS ext_missing,CASE WHEN cov.`f1` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS u0,CASE WHEN cov.`f2` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS u1 FROM current_rows cov
),
coverage_totals AS (
  SELECT coverage_flags.*,COUNT(*) OVER () AS observed,SUM(ext_missing) OVER () AS missing,SUM(u0) OVER () AS n0,SUM(u1) OVER () AS n1,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN ext_missing=1 OR u0=1 OR u1=1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,mktcode,tgtcode) AS sample_rank
  FROM coverage_flags
)
SELECT COALESCE(d.observed,0),COALESCE(d.missing,0),COALESCE(d.n0,0),COALESCE(d.n1,0),d.mktcode,d.tgtcode,d.ext_missing,d.u0,d.u1
FROM (SELECT 1 AS seed) s LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM coverage_totals WHERE sample_rank<=20) d ON TRUE
ORDER BY d.sample_rank;
